rules: Use the natural topic phrase early, followed by a concrete professional takeaway. This is an editorial recommendation, not a ranking formula.
Put the essential point in the opening one or two short lines. A universal 210-character see-more boundary was not established; display varies with layout.
Zero to three relevant hashtags at the end is our restraint choice, not a verified platform cap or guaranteed reach benefit.
No universal external-link penalty or benefit was established. No unpublished resource URL, link-in-bio claim, automatic DM promise or comment-keyword delivery CTA belongs in these review drafts.
No publishing, scheduling, account writes or automated engagement. A question should invite actual experience rather than comment-to-agree engagement bait.
Dubai/UAE context should be used only when relevant; do not imply local availability of every product or invent regional search demand.
Keep any AI-presenter disclosure accurate to the final asset. For the two avatar videos, retain AI avatar of me. Do not label a normal photo-only carousel as an AI-avatar video.
The 24 files and 30 languages are fictional story props, not measured product behavior. Keep the skit label visible.
The ai coding linkedin suggestions mix interview queries; do not treat that branch as proof of demand for comedy.
The exact named tools are not being compared by benchmark. Avoid claiming Claude or Codex always overengineers.
